label: TP
reason: Alert 1 (java/sql-injection): alert-TP — resolved sink value is the SQL string q = "UPDATE accounts SET note='" + param + "' WHERE id=1", where param is derived directly from request.getParameter("BenchmarkTest") without sanitization. Although execution is not performed in this method, the construction of the SQL string with unvalidated user input represents a vulnerability that could be exploited if the stored SQL is executed later. Case TP: at least one alert-TP.

evidence.note: User input param retrieved and concatenated directly into SQL string q
